label: Mac Mail
what: How many messages are unread in the Mail app on this Mac, and how long the oldest has waited.
reads: The unread count of the Mail inbox.
The date each unread message arrived, to work out the age of the oldest.
scopes: macOS Automation: allow the app that runs Quarterdeck to control Mail. There is no password and no key.
steps: Open the Mail app once and make sure an account is set up there.
The first refresh makes macOS ask whether the app that runs Quarterdeck may control Mail. Choose Allow.
If you chose Don't Allow, open System Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Automation. Turn on Mail under the app that runs Quarterdeck, then refresh.
Mail may open in the background while it reads the count. Nothing is changed in it.
revoke: Open System Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Automation, and turn Mail off for that app. Or switch Mac Mail off here.
tested: Parsing tested against sample data only; not tested against the real service.
